explanation: The English article says a unilateral declaration would normally have violated the Treaty of Berlin and been unlikely to be approved by the Great Powers, but that **"the chaos that ensued in the Ottoman Empire following the Young Turk Revolution of 1908 provided suitable conditions for the Bulgarian proclamation of independence"** — and that the Powers had turned to their own territorial gains instead, Austria-Hungary to Bosnia, Britain to the Arab provinces, Russia to the Straits. The revolution made the declaration possible; it did not call for it.
